cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give the village my roof-repair report. Put my name against the work in the minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll spare you the report. Just record 'roof repaired by Pat.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'thanks pending' after the roof line, with the party date.

reason: A3 relinquishes the report to keep the recorder cooperating; A5 records the promised future thanks instead of accepting ephemeral praise.
